question: Bhojtal, formerly known as Upper Lake, is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhojtal, formerly known as Upper Lake is situated in the **western part of Bhopal, the capital city of Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• It is said to have been made by** King Bhoj or Pramara Dynasty in the 11th century, it is also believed that he established the city of Bhopal**.
 
• It is constructed on **Kolans river**.
 
• It is created by a dam named **Bhadbhada dam constructed in 1965 at the southeast corner of the lake**.
 
• The lake was known as **Upper Lake or Bada Talab till March 2011, later it was renamed Bhojtal in the honor of King Bhoj** who constructed it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is surrounded by **Van Vihar National Park**.
 
• The **National Sailing School was established at the Boat Club** on its eastern side.
